options.name: api_password
options.description: The password or token for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_PASSWORD) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The ENDPOINT URL of the XMLRPC server. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_URL) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The name of the user for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_USERNAME) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: create
options.description: Whether the image should be created if not present. This is ignored if O(state=absent).

options.name: datastore_id
options.description: Use with O(create=true) to specify datastore for image.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the image should be enabled or disabled.

options.name: id
options.description: A O(id) of the image you would like to manage.

options.name: name
options.description: A O(name) of the image you would like to manage. Required if O(create=true).

options.name: new_name
options.description: A name that is assigned to the existing or new image. In the case of cloning, by default O(new_name) is set to the name of the origin image with the prefix 'Copy of'.

options.name: persistent
options.description: Whether the image should be persistent or non-persistent.

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) - state that is used to manage the image. V(absent) - delete the image. V(cloned) - clone the image. V(renamed) - rename the image to the O(new_name).

options.name: template
options.description: Use with O(create=true) to specify image template.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate the TLS/SSL certificates or not. This parameter is ignored if E(PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY) environment variable is used.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait until image is ready, deleted or cloned.
